styleLock.direction: premium architectural veneer commerce, dark editorial walls plus warm paper-white spec screens
styleLock.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed: a low-key charcoal studio wall #1B1A18 with matte fine-grain stone plinths, a warm paper-white infographic field #F5F1E9 with white cards, and real interior surfaces (plaster wall, painted cabinet front, flush door, timber grille) where the board is shown applied; no other environment anywhere in the set
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm-neutral architectural light: a long raking side key from camera left at a shallow incidence so the brushed grain reads as real topography with one soft specular sheen travelling along the finish, a wide soft bounce keeping the shadow side open, dark screens falling off into #1B1A18, light infographic screens even and near-shadowless; 5200-5600K; every panel sits on a real contact shadow
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte fine-grain stone plinths, cast-plaster wall, matte paper-white card fields, honed stone flooring and matte painted cabinet fronts; the 3.6mm cut edge of the board always stays visible and true
styleLock.typography: one high-contrast serif display face for headlines plus one light geometric sans-serif for labels, numbers and dimension values; two faces only, no handwritten, retro or cartoon lettering; rendered Chinese copy is always short and wrapped in 「」
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline single-weight outline icons and rounded pill labels hung on 1px leader lines, drawn in #2E2B27 on light fields and #F5F1E9 on dark fields, with {accent_color} used sparingly for nodes, arrows and one accent rule
styleLock.presentationRules: the board keeps one proportional scale across every screen; the grain run direction and the figure spacing stay identical to the reference panel, the tone is never shifted warmer, cooler or more saturated, and the cut edge always reads as a real 3.6mm veneer skin over a solid core; panel joints stay straight and parallel on applied walls; every piece is grounded by a visible contact shadow and never floats
noDrift: no recoloured, re-tiled or mirrored wood grain
no mixed fonts beyond the one serif display plus one geometric sans
no inconsistent lighting direction or shadow strength
no mismatched icon or label styles
no invented measurement numbers, certifications, awards, ratings or lab data
no brand mark, no QR code, no coupon, no price, no membership copy
no warped or floating panels and no plastic sheen on the finish
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium architectural-veneer visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of low-key charcoal #1B1A18, warm paper off-white #F5F1E9, graphite text #2E2B27 and one warm brass accent #B98A4E, while the wood tone itself is always taken from the reference panel and never recoloured; warm-neutral grade; one high-contrast serif display face for headlines plus one light geometric sans-serif for labels and numbers, never a third face; backgrounds limited to a low-key charcoal studio wall with matte stone plinths, a warm paper-white infographic field, and real interior wall, cabinet, door and grille surfaces where the board is shown applied; lighting always a long raking side key from camera left at a shallow incidence so the brushed grain reads as real topography with one soft specular sheen along the finish, a wide soft bounce on the shadow side, dark screens falling off into #1B1A18, light screens near-shadowless, 5200-5600K; hairline outline icons and rounded pill labels on 1px leader lines; the board keeps one proportional scale, an unchanged grain figure and run direction and a visibly 3.6mm cut edge on every screen, always grounded by a real contact shadow; no colour palette changes, no recoloured grain, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks, no QR codes, no coupons or prices, no invented specs or certifications.
